name: The Quarry Seals

premise.value: The three rune-seals on the old Hornblende quarry are failing. Foreman Aldric wants them checked; the Wandering Prospector wants them broken; and something beneath the rubble is waking up to judge whoever comes next.

stages.label: Unavailable
stages.entryCondition: Player has not yet visited Hornblende Ridge or spoken to Aldric.
stages.completionCondition: Player arrives at the ridge-side inn and Aldric is willing to talk.
stages.notes: Quest is hidden until the player reaches the ridge.

stages.label: Offered
stages.entryCondition: Player has reached the ridge and Aldric has sized them up.
stages.completionCondition: Player accepts the job of inspecting the seals.
stages.failureCondition: Player refuses and leaves the ridge.
stages.notes: Aldric gives context but withholds the sacred-site framing. The Prospector can also be met here.

stages.label: Seals investigated
stages.entryCondition: Player has reached the quarry mouth and examined at least one seal.
stages.completionCondition: Player has examined all three seals and confirmed they are failing.
stages.notes: Ambient stage; the golem is sensed but not yet confronted.

stages.label: Golem confronted
stages.entryCondition: Player has descended to the sealed vein and the golem has made contact.
stages.completionCondition: The first-encounter exchange resolves (kneel, parley, or fight).
stages.notes: The golem learns the player's intent here; relationship state is set.

stages.label: The choice
stages.entryCondition: Combat with the golem is underway (player refused to kneel).
stages.completionCondition: The golem is reduced to its final phase.
stages.notes: Branch point. Destroying the golem exposes the makers' marks (5a). Sparing it leaves the vein sealed (5b).

stages.label: Consequence — the truth
stages.entryCondition: Player destroyed the golem's central binding rune.
stages.completionCondition: Player has heard the golem's dying warning and the quest closes on the truth of the origin.
stages.notes: The origin is revealed ONLY on this branch. This is the design's biggest knowledge-gating test.

stages.label: Consequence — the seal holds
stages.entryCondition: Player spared the golem and withdrew.
stages.completionCondition: Player reports back to Aldric; the vein stays sealed.
stages.notes: The origin is NOT revealed on this branch. A future quest may revisit it.

consequences.value: The makers' marks are exposed; the origin becomes known.
Aldric is devastated; the Prospector is delighted.
The vein stays sealed; the origin stays secret.
Aldric is relieved; the Prospector is furious.

notes: The 5+ stage labels are the five narrative beats; stage_0 is the unavailable pre-state. The branch at stage 4 -> 5a/5b is the design's central knowledge-gating mechanism.
